== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Elysia]], also known as the City of [[Light]], is a legendary location characterized by its immense beauty and golden appearance. The city exists under an eternal sunrise, with a sky that remains a constant shade of gold. Its architecture is composed of vast white walls adorned with gems and precious metals, featuring silver and gold gates. The cityscape is defined by soaring towers made of various materials including bronze, copper, and gold, alongside massive structures like amethyst-colored buildings. The city is organized into different districts, such as the [[Gold District]] and the [[Green District]], which are separated by large walls. According to prophecy, a [[Traveler of Elysia]] is destined to return and lead the free city of [[Enosh]] to victory against the [[King of Damasca]]. While the city has remained without a [[Traveler]] for over three hundred and fifty years, its arrival is considered a major event. The city possesses unique properties, including the ability to produce golden light as a reward for courage and containing powers that serve as complements to other Territories. Access to the city is achieved through [[Gates]], which can range from small portals to massive openings spanning the width of the city itself. Though often viewed as a paradise for the virtuous, the city has also been a site of conflict and war.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The City of [[Light]] is a location associated with [[Elysia]] that contains various graves and is organized into nine distinct districts. This faction engages in combat against the [[House of Blades]], serving as a model for [[Enosh]], which was divided into nine districts to imitate it. Looking toward future conflicts, the [[Incarnations]] are set to launch an assault against the city.}}
